newsitem.title: USA: MIM Corp gets Sierra Health contract.
newsitem.headline: MIM Corp gets Sierra Health contract.

text.p: MIM Corp said Thursday that it has signed a contract to provide prescription benefit management services for Sierra Health Services Inc.

MIM, through its subsidiary Pro-Mark, will provide a risk/incentive program which will initially cover 281,000 members, consisting of 156,000 Commercial HMO Members, 31,000 Medicare HMO Members and 48,000 Managed Indemnity Lives, primarily in Nevada and Texas.
MIM/Pro-Mark will also provide services for 46,000 self-funded members under Sierra's administrative management.
In addition, the program will be offered to 236,000 more self-funded members under Sierra's administrative management as the members' existing agreements expire.
